description: Antennes relais dans les Mauges ou à proximité is a dataset listed in Data.maugescommunaute.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ANFR. Antennes relais situées sur le territoire de Mauges Communauté ou à proximité. Source: ANFR. Coverage: Mauges Communauté (Maine-et-Loire). The portal files it under Économie / Europe. Its keywords are antennes relais, 5G, réseaux mobiles. The portal shows 2,038 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-02-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-maugescommunaute-fr-portal.
